hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/blue-spring-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Each site is equipped with a picnic table, water, electricity and a grill') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 47 campsites: Electric Hookup 50, Water Hookup), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/blue-spring-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The campground has 51 campsites (recreational vehicles up to 40 feet long)') + Reserve Florida search/details for facility 24 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName: all Back In), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/blue-spring-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Two new bathhouses are complete with accessible showers and bathroom stalls'; 'The dump station is located in the campground'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve Florida warns that this Blue Spring (Volusia County, near Orange City) is not Lafayette Blue Springs State Park near Mayo: check the park before booking.

booking.source: https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/#!park/9 (place description: 'Please make sure you are reserving for the correct Blue Springs State Park'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 51 sites for RVs to 40 ft, all back-in, 50-amp electric and water, bathhouses with showers, dump station in the campground, reservable. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; units still $24 + utility). Window and fcfs left inherited. Sewer not stated.
